verdict.rationale: ADK's Python SDK and CLI (agents, tools, workflows, `adk run`) are extensively documented in human-readable docs, giving developers a clear public API surface to drive programmatically. However, probes show no machine-readable spec (llms.txt 404, OpenAPI/swagger 404, docs-as-markdown 404), meaning there's no AI-native-friendly structured API description despite claims of AI-assisted development. Missing for 10: machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt), independent confirmation of API stability/versioning for programmatic driving.
